items.stem: An AI assistant proposes a fix for an intermittent error on the first try. What should you do before applying it?

options.text: Reproduce the failure and confirm the hypothesis explains the intermittency
options.rationale: Correct: a fix is only sound once the cause is confirmed.

options.text: Apply it immediately since the assistant is usually right
options.rationale: Unverified fixes risk masking the real cause.
That avoids rather than diagnoses the bug.

items.stem: You hand a stack trace to an assistant. Which TWO additional pieces of context most improve its diagnosis? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Steps to reproduce and the expected vs actual behaviour
options.rationale: Correct: reproduction and expectations anchor the diagnosis.

options.text: Relevant recent changes or the failing input
options.rationale: Correct: recent diffs and inputs localise the cause.
